content:
The console is the simplest way to create a domain that uses warm storage. While creating the
domain, choose Enable warm data nodes and the number of warm nodes that you want. The
same basic process works on existing domains, provided they meet the prerequisites. Even after
the domain state changes from Processing to Active, UltraWarm might not be available to use for
several hours.
When using a Multi-AZ with Standby domain, the number of warm nodes must be a multiple of
the number of Availability Zones. For more information, see the section called “Multi-AZ with
Standby”.
You can also use the AWS CLI or conﬁguration API to enable UltraWarm, speciﬁcally the
WarmEnabled, WarmCount, and WarmType options in ClusterConfig.
Note
Domains support a maximum number of warm nodes. For details, see the section called
“Quotas”.
